finding.claim: No test covers the plain-merge fallback to the parent of the merge's second parent. Every merge test now carries the trailer, so it takes the new trailer path. Replacing the fallback with DRAFTED="" still passes all 23 release_tag tests, so row r2's claim that a plain merge falls back when no trailer is found is not checked.

fixes.change: _merge_release(trailer=False) now strips the Drafted-From trailer from a merged release commit too, and a new test merges a release with no trailer and checks the step falls back to the second parent's parent, naming the late commit and the drafted commit. It fails when the fallback line is replaced by DRAFTED="".
